definitions.gloss: to pile up; to stack up
definitions.explanation: to place things on top of each other to create a stack
to gradually gather or develop over time through sustained effort

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ブロック→ブロック：05902_burokku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{上|あ}げて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The child is stacking up blocks.

examples.english: I have accumulated years of experience.

examples.english: This is the result of accumulated effort.

notes:
{積|つ}み{上|あ}げる is a compound verb meaning to pile up or accumulate.

VERB TYPE:
- Ichidan verb (る-verb)
- Transitive
- Intransitive pair: {積|つ}み{上|あ}がる

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to pile, stack) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise)

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1: Physical stacking (boxes, blocks, bricks)
- Sense 2: Abstract accumulation (experience, trust, achievements)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{上|あ}げる (to accumulate experience)
- ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{上|あ}げる (to build up achievements)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{上|あ}げる (to build trust)
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{上|あ}げる (to stack luggage)
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{上|あ}げる (to accumulate effort)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {積|つ}み{上|あ}がる: Something piles up on its own
- {積|つ}み{上|あ}げる: Someone actively piles something

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to pile - base verb)
- ⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}する→蓄積する：25358_chikusekisuru⟧ (to accumulate - more formal)
- ⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to layer, repeat)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday speech and business contexts.
